searches.result: One Node stdio MCP dispatcher exposes exactly three tools.
Native Node Context7 request transport only; no shared HTTP route.
No production manifest or dependency declaration; no Rust/Swift bridge or npm import.

self_review: Challenged apparent overlap for cargo:rightkit-mcp and cargo:rightkit-http. Both have active Node-local mechanisms, but their owner APIs are Rust and Groundwork contains no binding, sidecar, or service bridge; retained NA rather than unsupported N. Challenged npm:@rightkit/agent-room-mcp and npm:@rightkit/ax: both concern MCP, but their exact room/conformance features are absent. Every catalog ID appears once; no Y/M claim lacks a production caller.
